definitions.gloss: to run away; to run off; to dash away
definitions.explanation: To leave a place quickly by running. A compound of 走る (to run) and 去る (to leave), emphasizing both the speed and the departure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{走|はし}り{去|さ}っていった。
⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{走|はし}り{去|さ}って⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: When called out to, the suspicious person ran off and disappeared.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧ (to go away). The ～⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧ pattern indicates moving away from the speaker's perspective, seen also in {飛|と}び{去|さ}る (to fly away) and {逃|に}げ{去|さ}る (to flee).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走|はし}り{去|さ}っていく (to run off in a direction away from the speaker)
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{走|はし}り{去|さ}る (to dash away in an instant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {駆|か}け{去|さ}る: to dash away — more literary or dramatic
- {逃|に}げ{去|さ}る: to flee — implies escaping from something
- ⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}す→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧: to start running — focuses on beginning rather than departing
